A reports greater weight reduction with TRE vs SOC; B reports a nonsignificant -1.4 kg vs UE and explicitly concludes TRE did not lead to significant improvements in weight compared with UE. source_evidence.quote: The TRE group also showed greater reductions in body weight, waist circumference, and body fat mass compared to the SOC group
In a 12-week intervention, TRE did not lead to significant improvements in weight, average body composition, or glycemic or metabolic measures compared with CR or UE.

verdict.label: not_replicated
verdict.rationale: Both are RCTs of time-restricted eating with a between-group weight-change contrast against a control arm (SOC in A, unrestricted eating in B), so the findings are comparable. A reports greater weight reduction with TRE vs SOC (sentence 9). B reports a nonsignificant -1.4 kg TRE vs UE (p=0.53) and explicitly concludes that TRE 'did not lead to significant improvements in weight... compared with CR or UE' (sentence 10), an explicit failure-to-confirm conclusion against A's reported effect, so not_replicated applies rather than concordance or contradiction.
